## Checklist

- [ ] I worked only within the approved stage.
- [ ] Canonical contracts/fixtures are reused rather than copied.
- [ ] No real credentials, identifiers, family data, private screenshots, logs, or signing material are included.
- [ ] Platform limitations and test provenance are stated honestly.
- [ ] Cleanup was listed first and removed only repository-owned output.
- [ ] No later-stage work, hidden behavior, arbitrary execution, or prohibited collection was introduced.
